releaseNotes: Terminal Engine Update: Full support for both Shizuku and iAdb elevated privileges.
Final Enterprise Update: Maxed out all Non-Root ADB tuning potential.
Fix Refresh Rate Display: Implemented Developer Settings bypass combined with SurfaceFlinger parcel calls to force overlay across all Android 11+ OEM devices.
New 'Game Driver Opt-In' Toggle: Force the Android graphics engine to deploy native Game Drivers globally.
New 'Disable Untrusted Touches' Toggle: Fixes the notorious input delay/touch blocking when overlay apps (like Discord/Messenger bubbles) are active.
New 'AFK Cafe Mode' Toggle: Allow infinite screen timeout (up to 24 Days) for heavy auto-grinding games.
New 'Optimize HWUI Overdraw': Command the GPU to ignore rendering dirty and hidden regions, slashing thermal buildup and boosting raw FPS.
Network Scoring Override: Disabled background network evaluation to stop Android from randomly scanning and rating Wi-Fi bands mid-game.
Ultimate Game Booster Finalized: The full boost script is now the most aggressive and safest execution pipeline available for non-root users.
